diag.note: searchToDispatchMs starts at the SEARCH CLICK, before the main table read. responseMs is server AND network, never server time - server.serverDurationMs is the server half and server.canonicalRead splits it further. domWorkMs is SYNCHRONOUS DOM WORK ONLY and is NOT a paint. paintOpportunityMs is taken after two animation frames: it is an APPROXIMATION of the earliest moment the browser COULD have painted, never an observation that anything was shown - the page cannot see the operator screen, and no figure here may be quoted as a visible instant. It is bound to the request that scheduled it (timing.forSeq); null means no frame ran for THAT request, not that nothing rendered.
